name: perf-bloor
js: (()=>{const app=window.__CITY_APP;app.teleportTo(-1319.9,-2816.2,0);const cam={pos:[-1359.9, 2.2, -2815.3],look:[-1460.0, 0.4, -2816.6],fov:55};app.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>cam;})();(async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await sleep(2500);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<5000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});console.log('[perf] perf-bloor '+((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(2)+' ms')})()
